newsitem.title: USA: Riddell sees 1996 revs topping $70 mln.
newsitem.headline: Riddell sees 1996 revs topping $70 mln.

text.p: Riddell Sports Inc Thursday said that while fourth-quarter results will not be available until March, it expects 1996 revenues to exceed $70 million.

In a statement, the company said David Mauer, chief executive officer, told a group of financial analysts that Riddell's goal was to continue to introduce new products for sale to the institutional and retail collectible markets.
Riddell sells sporting goods products and services for football and other sports.
